notes:
• Android app: tells you when a new version is out ("Pocket 0.5.0 is available" with Download over the workspace list), and Settings shows the installed version with "Check for updates".
• The phone apps only connect over https (Tailscale Serve), so the pairing token never crosses a network in the clear. An http address is refused with "Pocket only connects over https. Turn on Tailscale Serve in Pocket Host and scan its code again."
• Android app: connects only over https (Tailscale Serve); a pairing with a plain http address says "Pocket only connects over https. Turn on Tailscale Serve in Pocket Host and scan its code again."
